notifications.welcomeBody:
Ga ta jagorar sauri don kewayawa:

• Gida — Katin gaggawa, Kulawa kusa, Koyo, da gajerun hanya
• Apps — Magani, allurar rigakafi, bincike, ciki, da bin lokaci
• Iyali — Bayanan gida da raba kulawar yara
• Bayani — Patient ID, saituna, da abubuwan da aka fi so

Wannan agogon yana tara sabuntawa a wuri guda. Bincika a saurin ku — CareMate yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
